description: What has just been filed with the SEC, across every company: EDGAR's latest-filings feed, newest first by acceptance time, filtered by form (8-K, 10-K, 4, SC 13D, S-1...), 8-K event (earnings, executive change, restatement, bankruptcy), words in the filer's name and time. For watching what comes in today and over the last few business days; list_filings and company_events reach further back.

company.description: Words that must all appear in the filer's name, e.g. "bancorp" or "apple".

event.description: 8-K filings with this item only: an item number (2.02) or a name (earnings, executive_change, restatement, bankruptcy, cybersecurity_incident...).

forms.description: Form types, e.g. ["8-K"], ["10-K", "10-Q"], ["4"], ["SC 13D"], ["S-1"]; each also matches its amendments (8-K/A). Default: every form.

since.description: Accepted at or after this time (a date means its start, US Eastern). Default: everything the feed holds.

name: latest_filings

outputSchema.description: rows are filings in the order of columns, newest first by acceptance time; items are an 8-K's item numbers, events their names.

title: Latest filings (EDGAR feed)
